query:
SELECT r.id, r.name, r.category, r.gamme
FROM recettes r
LEFT JOIN molecules_recettes mr ON r.id = mr.recette_id
WHERE mr.id IS NULL
ORDER BY r.gamme, r.name
LIMIT 50;
